meta.name: Frontend Product Builder Form Field Foundation Components
meta.description: Canonical form-field composition, help, error, character-count, grouped-input, and search-input components.

FormField.name: FormField
FormField.description: Canonical composition connecting one form control to its visible label, required state, help, validation error, supporting content, and accessibility relationships.
capabilities: Associate one visible label with one primary form control.
Present optional, required, disabled, read-only, invalid, and pending field states.
Connect help and error text through programmatic relationships.
Preserve field anatomy and spacing across control types.
Support React Hook Form or controlled feature composition without owning business validation.
Prevent placeholder text from replacing the field label.

foundation.source: Native label semantics, Stack, FieldHelp, FieldError
foundation.reason: Field composition requires stable labeling, description relationships, validation state, spacing ownership, and control-slot contracts beyond a generic wrapper.

default.intent: Present an ordinary editable application field.
prohibitedUse: Checkbox or radio layout requiring specialized field composition.

compact.intent: Present an ordinary field in a dense but still readable operational form.
prohibitedUse: Using density to conceal excessive field count.

readOnly.intent: Present a form-associated value that participates in workflow context but is not editable.
allowedUse: Calculated field displayed beside editable fields.
prohibitedUse: Ordinary entity-detail attributes better represented by DefinitionList.
Using disabled inputs to represent all read-only content.
Protected values that must not be disclosed.

compact.intent: Dense field spacing for approved operational contexts.

comfortable.intent: Expanded spacing for complex instructions or high-attention input.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Visible field label associated with the primary control.
contentRestrictions: The label must identify the expected value.
Placeholder text must not replace the label.
Do not include implementation or DTO terminology.

slots.name: requiredIndicator
slots.description: Optional localized indication that the value is required.
contentRestrictions: Required state must also exist in form semantics.
An asterisk alone must have an accessible explanation in the form context.

slots.name: labelAction
slots.description: Optional low-frequency action directly related to the field label.
contentRestrictions: Use sparingly.
Essential help must remain visible.
The action must not compete with the primary form workflow.

slots.name: control
slots.description: One primary approved form control.
contentRestrictions: One FormField normally owns one primary form value.
Multiple related choices require a specialized group field.

slots.name: supporting
slots.description: Optional unit, prefix explanation, value provenance, or compact supporting context.
contentRestrictions: Supporting content must not replace FieldHelp or FieldError.
Critical validation information belongs in FieldError.

slots.name: help
slots.description: Optional persistent instruction or constraint.
contentRestrictions: Explain only information needed to enter or understand the value.
Avoid repeating the label.

slots.name: error
slots.description: Current user-correctable field validation error.
contentRestrictions: Only render when the error is relevant according to the validation-display policy.
Do not expose raw schema or server implementation messages.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable DOM identity used to associate label, control, help, and error.
restrictions: Must be unique within the rendered document.
Must not be regenerated on every render.

props.name: name
props.description: Form-field name used by the owning form library or native form submission.
restrictions: The field name is not shown directly to the user.
Nested paths must remain stable.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic presentation mode.
restrictions: Do not select readOnly only to obtain a subtle background.

props.name: size
props.description: Approved field-spacing density.
restrictions: Individual child margins must not override the field anatomy.

props.name: required
props.description: Indicates that the form schema requires a value.
restrictions: Must remain consistent with validation and native control semantics.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Indicates that the current field value fails the active validation policy.
restrictions: Invalid state normally requires an associated FieldError.
Do not mark untouched fields invalid before the project validation policy allows it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Indicates that the user cannot interact with the control and the value may not participate in submission.
restrictions: Disabled and read-only have different form semantics.
A disabled field requires a valid eligibility reason when the reason is not obvious.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Indicates that the current value is visible and retained but not editable.
restrictions: Use only when the selected control supports valid read-only behavior.
Read-only display outside a form may require DefinitionList instead.

props.name: loading
props.description: Indicates that a field-specific dependency is pending.
restrictions: The form must not present incomplete authoritative values as final.
Loading does not automatically disable unrelated fields.

prohibitedParents: DataTable cell without an explicit inline-editing pattern
spacingOwnership: FormField owns spacing among label, control, supporting content, help, and error.
The control owns its internal padding.
The form layout owns spacing among sibling FormField components.
composition.surfaceOwnership: FormField owns no independent card surface by default.
rules: One field composition has one primary accessible label.
Help and error relationships use stable IDs.
Error content supersedes conflicting help content but does not have to remove useful instructions.
The owning form controls value, validation, dirty state, and submission.
Read-only and disabled states remain distinct.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Canonical wrapper for ordinary single-value fields.
Credential controls require appropriate autocomplete and safe error messaging.
Capability and read-only states remain explicit.
Human rationale and decision fields use visible labels and explicit validation.
Compact filters may use FormField, but the primary collection search normally uses SearchInput.

notes: The owning form library or feature owns field value, touched state, dirty state, and validation.
FormField receives resolved state and accessibility identifiers.
The composition may focus the control when its label is activated.
The owning workflow controls focus movement after validation or submission.

responsive.strategy: Preserve label-control-help-error association while allowing supporting content and label actions to wrap.
responsive.compact: Label actions move below or beside the label only when readable. Controls normally fill the field width.
responsive.medium: Use the owning form-grid width and ordinary field anatomy.
responsive.wide: Field width remains appropriate to expected content rather than expanding indefinitely.
responsive.ultrawide: The form recipe constrains field width.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Labels, help, errors, and supporting content wrap. Controls must not exceed the parent.
responsive.zoomExpectation: The complete field anatomy remains understandable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: field wrapper containing a native label and associated form control
keyboard: The control follows its native or approved foundation keyboard interaction.
Label actions remain separately keyboard operable.
focus: Activating the label focuses or activates the associated control.
Validation does not remove user-entered values.
The field wrapper is not focusable by default.
announcements: Validation errors are programmatically associated with the control.
Required, disabled, read-only, and pending states are perceivable.
Errors are not announced repeatedly on every render.
aria: Use aria-describedby for help and error content.
Prefer native required, disabled, and read-only semantics where supported.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Required, invalid, disabled, read-only, and pending meaning do not depend only on color.

content.minimum: One visible label and one associated primary control.
content.typical: Label, control, optional help, and conditional validation error.
content.maximum: One coherent value-entry composition. Related multi-control choices require a specialized field.
content.wrapping: Labels, help, supporting content, and errors wrap naturally.
content.truncation: Do not truncate labels or validation errors into ambiguity.
content.localization: Support expanded labels, instructions, validation messages, and required-state language.
content.emptyBehavior: A FormField without a label or control is invalid.
content.technicalContent: Raw schema paths, DTO names, validation codes, field keys, and server exception messages are prohibited.

notes: CheckboxField and RadioGroupField use specialized compositions because their label and control relationships differ from ordinary single-control fields.

FieldHelp.name: FieldHelp
FieldHelp.description: Canonical persistent supporting instruction for a form field, including constraints, examples, units, and noncritical guidance.
capabilities: Explain how to complete or interpret a form field.
Communicate persistent constraints before validation fails.
Provide concise examples and formatting guidance.
Associate help content programmatically with the control.
Remain available to pointer, keyboard, touch, and assistive-technology users.

foundation.source: Native descriptive text and approved typography tokens
foundation.reason: Persistent field guidance requires constrained content, programmatic association, stable styling, and separation from validation errors and tooltips.

instruction.intent: Explain how the user should enter or select the value.

constraint.intent: Communicate an input limit or rule before failure.

example.intent: Provide a concise localized example of an acceptable value.

context.intent: Explain why the field is requested or how the value will be used.

compact.intent: Short constraint or hint in a dense field.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Optional supplementary information icon.
contentRestrictions: The icon is decorative unless it conveys additional meaning.
Do not place an information icon beside every field.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Persistent concise guidance.
contentRestrictions: Use direct user-facing language.
Inline code is allowed only for values users genuinely enter or recognize.

slots.name: link
slots.description: Optional link to additional relevant documentation.
contentRestrictions: The field remains completable without opening external documentation.
The link label must identify the destination.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable descriptive ID referenced by the associated control.
restrictions: Must be unique in the rendered document.
Must remain stable across renders.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic type of field guidance.
restrictions: Do not use a variant only to change typography.

props.name: size
props.description: Approved guidance typography size.
restrictions: Text must remain readable at enlarged text settings.

spacingOwnership: FieldHelp owns spacing among optional icon, content, and link.
The owning field controls spacing above and below FieldHelp.
rules: Essential guidance remains visible and is not tooltip-only.
Help content is distinct from current validation errors.
The associated control references the help ID.
Help remains concise and field-specific.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use when a field has a non-obvious requirement or constraint.
Avoid revealing sensitive account or credential rules unnecessarily.
Explain operational consequences before submission.
Explain expected rationale or decision evidence.

prohibited: Fetching help text dynamically without a feature owner.

notes: The owning field supplies localized help content.
Optional documentation links retain their own semantic navigation behavior.

responsive.strategy: Wrap naturally below the associated control without exceeding the field width.
responsive.compact: Use concise content and allow links to move to a new line.
responsive.wide: Remain constrained by the field rather than the route.
responsive.ultrawide: Do not expand the reading line.
responsive.overflowPolicy: Text and inline examples wrap safely.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain readable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: descriptive text element associated through aria-describedby
accessibility.accessibleName: Content is read as the associated control description.
focus: Help does not alter field focus order.
announcements: Help is available when the associated control receives focus through programmatic description.
Static help is not a live region.
aria: The control references FieldHelp through aria-describedby.
Decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Help meaning is communicated through text rather than color.

content.typical: One sentence describing format, constraint, example, or value use.
content.maximum: Two short sentences and one optional documentation link.
content.localization: Support expanded instructions, examples, and links.
content.emptyBehavior: An empty FieldHelp does not render.
content.technicalContent: Raw schema expressions, regex patterns, API field names, and implementation terminology are prohibited unless the user must genuinely enter or understand them.

FieldError.name: FieldError
FieldError.description: Canonical user-correctable validation message associated with one form field.
capabilities: Explain why the current field value is invalid.
Provide a direct correction-oriented message.
Associate validation feedback programmatically with the field control.
Normalize client and safe field-level server validation messages.
Avoid leaking schema, transport, or backend implementation details.

foundation.source: Native descriptive text, semantic danger tokens, approved validation-message adapter
foundation.reason: Field validation requires programmatic association, controlled announcement, safe message normalization, consistent styling, and correction-oriented content.

validation.intent: Communicate a client- or schema-detected invalid field value.
allowedUse: Cross-field constraint attributed to one field.

server.intent: Communicate a normalized server validation error attributable to one field.
allowedUse: Server rejected a field-specific business constraint.
Current value conflicts with an authoritative field rule.

blockingConstraint.intent: Communicate a field-specific condition that blocks continuation until another value or prerequisite changes.
allowedUse: Selected option is incompatible with another field.
Current field cannot be modified in the selected workflow state.

compact.intent: Short validation message in a dense field.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Optional semantic error icon.
contentRestrictions: The icon is supplementary.
The message must remain understandable without it.

slots.name: message
slots.description: Correction-oriented validation message.
contentRestrictions: Explain the expected correction.
Do not display raw validation codes, schema paths, or backend messages.

slots.name: action
slots.description: Optional low-frequency field-specific recovery action.
contentRestrictions: Use only when the action directly resolves the field error.
Ordinary value correction should occur through the field control.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable error-message ID referenced by the associated invalid control.
restrictions: Must be unique and stable.

props.name: variant
props.description: Source and operational meaning of the field error.
restrictions: Server variant still requires normalized user-facing content.

props.name: size
props.description: Approved validation-message typography size.
restrictions: Do not reduce text below readable design-system thresholds.

props.name: announcement
props.description: Live-announcement policy selected by the owning validation workflow.
restrictions: Do not announce the same error repeatedly.
Assertive behavior is reserved for unusual urgent blocking feedback.

prohibitedParents: FormErrorSummary as duplicate content without field navigation purpose
Toast as the only field error
spacingOwnership: FieldError owns spacing among icon, message, and optional action.
The owning field controls spacing above FieldError.
composition.surfaceOwnership: FieldError normally owns no independent surface.
rules: The associated control exposes invalid semantics.
The message is specific and correction-oriented.
Raw validation output is normalized before rendering.
The owning workflow determines when an error becomes visible.
Form-level errors remain separate.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Field errors remain adjacent to their associated controls.
Messages must avoid account enumeration and unsafe credential disclosure.
Business-rule errors must be normalized.
Decision rationale and confirmation errors require direct correction guidance.

notes: The owning form supplies one normalized message and announcement policy.
Optional recovery action callbacks are supplied externally.

responsive.strategy: Wrap naturally below the field while remaining visually connected to the control.
responsive.compact: Use concise text and stack optional action.
responsive.wide: Remain constrained by the associated field.
responsive.ultrawide: Do not expand line length with the route.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain readable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: descriptive validation text associated with an invalid control
keyboard: Static error text is not focusable.
Optional recovery actions are keyboard operable.
focus: The owning form may focus the invalid control or summary link.
FieldError itself normally does not receive focus.
announcements: Newly relevant errors may be announced politely.
The same unchanged message is not repeatedly announced.
Submission errors may also be summarized by FormErrorSummary.
aria: The control references the error through aria-describedby.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Invalid meaning is communicated through text and semantics in addition to color.

content.typical: One sentence explaining the invalid value and expected correction.
content.maximum: Two concise sentences and one optional direct recovery action.
content.localization: Support expanded validation language and action labels.
content.emptyBehavior: An empty FieldError does not render.
content.technicalContent: Schema paths, issue codes, stack traces, HTTP status text, SQL errors, and internal business-rule identifiers are prohibited.

CharacterCount.name: CharacterCount
CharacterCount.description: Canonical character-length feedback for text controls with explicit limits, warning thresholds, accessibility behavior, and localized count presentation.
capabilities: Present current and maximum character count.
Communicate approaching-limit and exceeded-limit states.
Distinguish informational counting from actual validation.
Associate the count with the related text control.
Avoid excessive live announcements during typing.

foundation.source: Localized number formatting and descriptive status text
foundation.reason: Character count requires consistent thresholds, invalid-state distinction, localization, programmatic association, and non-disruptive announcements.

used.intent: Show characters used relative to the maximum.
allowedUse: Current and maximum display such as 120 de 500.
prohibitedUse: The product requires a remaining-count mental model.

remaining.intent: Show how many characters remain before reaching the limit.
allowedUse: Content where remaining capacity is operationally more useful.
prohibitedUse: Negative count is displayed without invalid explanation.

compact.intent: Compact count beside or beneath a short text field.

default.intent: Ordinary count for longer text entry.

slots.name: count
slots.description: Localized current count or remaining count.
contentRestrictions: Use localized number formatting.
Do not expose implementation-specific string length details.

slots.name: limit
slots.description: Optional visible maximum character limit.
contentRestrictions: Required for used mode.
Must remain consistent with the actual validation schema.

props.name: variant
props.description: Count mental model.
restrictions: Use one model consistently within the product.

props.name: current
props.description: Current authoritative character count.
restrictions: Must be zero or greater.
The component does not derive count from arbitrary children.

props.name: maximum
props.description: Maximum length defined by the active validation contract.
restrictions: Must be greater than zero.
Must match client and server constraints.

props.name: warningThreshold
props.description: Count at which warning presentation begins.
restrictions: Must be below or equal to maximum.
Use a product default rather than arbitrary per-screen values.

props.name: size
props.description: Approved count typography size.

spacingOwnership: CharacterCount owns spacing between count and limit.
The owning field positions the count relative to help and error content.
rules: The count does not replace maxLength or schema validation.
Exceeded state requires an associated field error when submission is invalid.
Typing must not generate excessive announcements.
Thresholds remain synchronized with validation.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use for text controls with meaningful maximum length.
Useful for rationale limits when the limit is operationally meaningful.
Use for bounded labels, descriptions, or templates.

notes: The owning field supplies current and maximum counts.

responsive.strategy: Remain compact and aligned with supporting field content.
responsive.compact: May wrap below other supporting information.
responsive.medium: Align at the end of the supporting row when space permits.
responsive.wide: Remain constrained to the field width.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain legible at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: descriptive status text associated with the control
announcements: Do not announce every character typed.
Warning or exceeded thresholds may be announced once according to the owning field policy.
The associated FieldError communicates invalid submission.
aria: Associate through aria-describedby when the count is relevant to the control.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Approaching and exceeded states use text and semantics in addition to color.

content.minimum: Current count and maximum or remaining capacity.
content.typical: Localized count such as 120 de 500 caracteres.
content.localization: Support pluralization and localized number formatting.
content.emptyBehavior: Does not render when no maximum exists.
content.technicalContent: UTF implementation details, byte count, code-unit count, and schema internals are prohibited unless explicitly relevant.

InputGroup.name: InputGroup
InputGroup.description: Canonical composition for one input combined with a meaningful prefix, suffix, unit, inline action, or status without breaking field semantics.
capabilities: Combine one primary input with a visible prefix or suffix.
Present units, currencies, domains, protocols, or compact supporting text.
Include an approved inline action such as reveal, copy, or clear.
Preserve one accessible field label and one primary form value.
Communicate disabled, read-only, invalid, and pending states coherently across the group.

foundation.reason: Grouped inputs require coordinated borders, focus treatment, semantic slot restrictions, one value owner, and accessible inline actions.

prefix.intent: Present a fixed prefix before the editable value.
prohibitedUse: A prefix whose meaning is not visible or announced.

suffix.intent: Present a fixed unit or suffix after the editable value.

action.intent: Place one compact input-specific action beside the primary control.

combined.intent: Combine a fixed prefix or suffix with one approved inline action.

compact.intent: Dense grouped input for compact operational contexts.

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: Optional fixed content before the control.
contentRestrictions: Prefix must be concise and non-editable.
Meaning must be perceivable to assistive technology.

slots.name: control
slots.description: One primary form control.
contentRestrictions: Only one primary editable value.
The InputGroup does not own a second form field.

slots.name: suffix
slots.description: Optional fixed content after the control.
contentRestrictions: Suffix must be concise and non-editable.
Ambiguous units require visible or associated explanation.

slots.name: action
slots.description: Optional compact action directly related to the current input.
contentRestrictions: One action only.
Icon-only actions require accessible names.
The action must not submit the complete form unless explicitly acting as the field control.

slots.name: status
slots.description: Optional compact pending, success, or availability indication.
contentRestrictions: Do not use status as a replacement for FieldError.
Dynamic success should not remain permanently decorative.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic grouped-input anatomy.
restrictions: The variant must match the actual slots.

props.name: size
props.description: Approved grouped-control height and spacing.
restrictions: All direct control regions share a coherent height.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Applies a coherent invalid state to the group and primary control.
restrictions: An invalid group requires an associated FieldError through FormField.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the primary control and related action when appropriate.
restrictions: Decorative prefix and suffix remain perceivable.
Action eligibility must remain consistent with the input.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the editable control read-only while retaining the visible value.
restrictions: Copy action may remain available when policy allows it.

spacingOwnership: InputGroup owns internal borders, region spacing, and coordinated focus treatment.
FormField owns label, help, error, and external spacing.
The embedded Input retains text padding but does not add an independent outer border.
composition.surfaceOwnership: InputGroup owns one unified control surface.
rules: One group represents one primary value.
Prefix and suffix are not submitted as independent fields.
Inline actions must remain directly related to the input.
The group preserves one coherent focus and invalid-state treatment.
Do not use arbitrary negative margins to visually merge controls.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Use when one value requires a fixed unit, prefix, suffix, or local action.
Password reveal uses an accessible inline action.
Useful for domains, identifiers, units, and approved generated values.
SearchInput remains preferred for the primary collection search.

notes: The owning field controls value, invalid state, disabled state, read-only state, and action callbacks.
Inline action side effects such as copy or reveal are supplied by the owning field.
Focus remains inside the grouped control.

responsive.strategy: Preserve one unified control while constraining prefixes, suffixes, and actions.
responsive.compact: Use concise fixed content and one compact action. Long units may move to FieldHelp.
responsive.wide: The field width remains determined by expected value length.
responsive.ultrawide: Does not expand to fill route width automatically.
responsive.overflowPolicy: The editable control shrinks before fixed actions. Fixed labels must not force page overflow.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Regions must remain distinguishable and operable at 200% text scaling.

accessibility.semanticElement: grouped visual control preserving native input and button semantics
accessibility.accessibleName: Supplied by the owning FormField label.
keyboard: The input uses native editing behavior.
Inline action is independently keyboard operable.
Tab order follows input then action unless the action must logically precede it.
focus: The group displays coherent focus-within treatment.
Individual interactive controls retain visible focus.
Activating an action must not unexpectedly remove input focus unless required.
announcements: Prefix and suffix meaning are included in the accessible description when needed.
Pending or status changes are announced only when operationally useful.
aria: Do not hide meaningful units from assistive technology.
The primary control receives invalid and descriptive relationships.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Focus, invalid, disabled, read-only, and pending states use semantics and structure in addition to color.

content.minimum: One Input and one meaningful fixed region or action.
content.typical: Input with a short unit, prefix, suffix, or one inline action.
content.maximum: One input, two fixed supporting regions, and one directly related action.
content.wrapping: The complete control normally remains one line; lengthy explanation moves to FieldHelp.
content.truncation: Do not truncate units or prefixes into ambiguity.
content.localization: Support expanded units and action labels while preserving one usable control.
content.emptyBehavior: Without prefix, suffix, action, or status, use Input directly.
content.technicalContent: Internal field prefixes, database namespaces, and transport formatting are prohibited unless users genuinely enter or recognize them.

SearchInput.name: SearchInput
SearchInput.description: Canonical search-query input with explicit search semantics, controlled value, clear behavior, optional submission, pending state, keyboard support, and URL-state integration owned externally.
capabilities: Receive a user search query.
Expose native search semantics and clear behavior.
Support immediate, debounced, or explicit-submit search modes.
Communicate pending search without replacing existing results.
Integrate with URL-owned query state through controlled props.
Preserve query values across result loading and error states.

foundation.reason: Search requires a specialized semantic control with clear behavior, input-mode policy, pending feedback, accessible labels, and controlled synchronization.

instant.intent: Update the owning search state after an approved debounce while the user types.
allowedUse: Searchable collection with server or client filtering.
Search where each query update is safe and reversible.
prohibitedUse: Expensive operation without debounce and cancellation.
Search requiring a complete multi-field submission.

submit.intent: Update the owning search only after explicit user submission.
allowedUse: Search requiring a stable complete phrase.
Search where explicit invocation improves user control.
prohibitedUse: Tiny local filtering interaction where submission adds needless friction.

local.intent: Filter an already available bounded collection locally.
prohibitedUse: Partial server page presented as if the complete dataset were local.

compact.intent: Present search inside a constrained toolbar, drawer, or contextual panel.
prohibitedUse: Primary search requiring long queries or visible instructions.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Search icon identifying the control purpose.
contentRestrictions: The icon is supplementary and does not replace the accessible label.

slots.name: control
slots.description: Native search input.
contentRestrictions: Use type=search where behavior is appropriate.
The input requires a visible or visually hidden accessible label.

slots.name: pending
slots.description: Optional compact indication that a search update is pending.
contentRestrictions: Existing results remain visible while searching.
Do not announce every debounced request.

slots.name: clearAction
slots.description: Optional action clearing the current query.
contentRestrictions: Render only when a query exists.
Require an accessible label such as Limpar busca.

slots.name: submitAction
slots.description: Optional explicit search action.
contentRestrictions: Required only in submit mode.
Label or accessible name must identify search execution.

slots.name: shortcut
slots.description: Optional discoverability hint for a supported keyboard shortcut.
contentRestrictions: Display only when the shortcut actually exists.
Do not interfere with ordinary input typing.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic search execution model.
restrictions: The selected mode must match collection size, backend behavior, and expected request cost.

props.name: size
props.description: Approved control height and density.
restrictions: Compact does not remove the accessible label.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled current query text.
restrictions: The component does not own URL state.
The value remains visible during pending requests.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Controlled input-change callback.
restrictions: The callback does not execute the remote request directly inside the shared component.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Explicit search-submission callback.
restrictions: Required for submit mode.
Must not reload the browser unintentionally.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Clears the query through the owning state model.
restrictions: Clearing must also reconcile URL state and pagination when those are externally owned.

props.name: loading
props.description: Indicates that the current query is being resolved.
restrictions: Must not clear current results.
Must not prevent query editing unless the search contract requires it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Indicates that search is unavailable.
restrictions: The reason should be visible when not obvious.

props.name: minimumLength
props.description: Minimum query length before instant or submitted search is eligible.
restrictions: Must be justified by product or backend behavior.
The user receives visible guidance when the value is greater than zero.

prohibitedParents: FormField when a duplicate external label creates redundant semantics
spacingOwnership: SearchInput owns spacing and grouping among icon, input, pending indicator, clear action, submit action, and shortcut.
The search-and-filters region owns spacing around SearchInput and between search and filters.
composition.surfaceOwnership: SearchInput owns one unified search-control surface.
rules: Search mode is explicit.
Remote search uses approved debounce, cancellation, and query ownership outside the shared component.
Existing results remain visible during background search.
Clearing query reconciles external pagination and URL state.
Primary search remains distinguishable from filters.

recipeCompatibility.notes: Canonical primary text search for a searchable collection.
Search users, roles, integrations, or audit events through the correct server or local model.
Use to search bounded or server-backed evidence collections.
Use for related-record collections, not entity identity.
Global search requires a dedicated product contract and must not be improvised.

prohibited: Reading or writing URL search parameters.
Debouncing network requests internally without an explicit adapter.

notes: The owning screen, feature, or URL adapter controls query text.
Remote result data remains query-owned outside the component.
Search, clear, shortcut, and submission callbacks are supplied externally.
The component may focus the input through an approved shortcut.

responsive.strategy: Preserve query visibility, clear behavior, and search execution while moving low-priority hints out of constrained space.
responsive.compact: Fill the available width. Hide nonessential shortcut hints. Preserve clear and submit actions.
responsive.medium: Use the primary search-region width and allow adjacent filters to wrap.
responsive.wide: Use a constrained search width appropriate to expected query length.
responsive.ultrawide: Do not stretch across the complete route unless the product contract requires a global search bar.
responsive.overflowPolicy: The input shrinks before actions. Labels and pending context must not create page overflow.
responsive.zoomExpectation: Must remain operable at 200% text scaling and 125% browser zoom.

accessibility.semanticElement: search input inside a labeled search region or form where appropriate
accessibility.accessibleName: Visible or visually hidden label naming the searched collection or domain.
keyboard: Escape may clear only when the product keyboard policy defines it.
Clear and submit actions are keyboard operable.
Supported shortcuts must not override ordinary text entry unexpectedly.
focus: Clear action returns focus to the search input.
Pending result updates do not reset focus.
Search-result navigation follows the owning collection policy.
announcements: Pending requests are not announced on every keystroke.
Result counts and no-results states are announced by the owning collection.
Clearing the query may trigger a concise result-state update.
aria: Icon-only clear and submit actions require explicit names.
Use aria-busy only on the appropriate results or search region.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Focus, disabled, pending, and invalid state do not depend only on color.

content.minimum: An accessible search label and editable query input.
content.typical: Search icon, input, conditional clear action, and optional pending indicator.
content.maximum: One query input, clear action, optional submit action, and optional shortcut hint.
content.wrapping: The unified control remains one line; external filter regions wrap separately.
content.truncation: The editable query uses native input scrolling rather than visual ellipsis.
content.localization: Support expanded labels, placeholder examples, clear actions, and submit actions.
content.emptyBehavior: An empty query represents the unfiltered or default collection state according to the owning feature.
content.technicalContent: Query syntax, search engine operators, database field names, and endpoint parameters are prohibited unless explicitly supported for expert users.

notes: Debounce, URL synchronization, pagination reset, request cancellation, and query execution belong to the owning feature or screen adapter.

checks.description: The form-field foundation catalog must validate against the component catalog schema.
checks.remediation: Correct invalid or missing form-field component fields.

checks.description: Form-field component IDs, names, implementations, public imports, and responsibilities must remain unique.
checks.remediation: Resolve duplicate ownership or merge overlapping field components.

checks.description: Shared field components must not execute queries, mutations, business validation, permission checks, URL synchronization, or transport parsing.
checks.remediation: Move data access, validation ownership, permission logic, and side effects to the owning form, feature, or route.

checks.description: Every ordinary form control must have a visible or explicitly approved visually hidden label and correctly associated help and validation content.
checks.remediation: Correct label, htmlFor, id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required, disabled, or read-only relationships.

checks.description: Help, field validation, form-level errors, loading, permission, and read-only states must remain semantically distinct.
checks.remediation: Replace the message or field treatment with the canonical component matching the actual state.

checks.description: Placeholder text must not replace a visible field label.
checks.remediation: Add a visible label and retain placeholder text only as optional example content.

checks.description: Form fields must remain readable, operable, correctly associated, and free from page-level horizontal overflow across approved viewports and zoom levels.
checks.remediation: Correct field width, wrapping, label actions, grouped controls, error placement, or responsive form layout.

checks.description: SearchInput must preserve current results during pending remote search and must not execute remote data access directly.
checks.remediation: Move debounce, query execution, URL state, pagination reset, and cancellation to the owning feature.

checks.description: CharacterCount limits must remain synchronized with active client and server validation.
checks.remediation: Use one authoritative field schema and pass the resolved limit into the component.

checks.description: Page-local field wrappers, help text, validation messages, grouped inputs, character counters, and search boxes similar to canonical components require review.
checks.remediation: Reuse the canonical field component or document why the local composition is semantically distinct.
